evals.name: shadcn-evolve-existing
evals.prompt: Il tema del mio progetto shadcn (evals/files/globals.css) è tutto grigio. Voglio un primary verde petrolio e titoli più eleganti, ma i neutri devono restare sobri. Fammi vedere qualche alternativa.
evals.expected_output: shadcn mode without asking (components/tokens are shadcn), 2–3 candidates with a teal primary that differ in neutrals, radius or heading font; preview.html with light and dark samples; every text pair passes AA; ends asking which candidate. Nothing is written to globals.css before the choice.

evals.name: tailwind-brand-color
evals.prompt: Brand color #e85d04 per un'app di food delivery. Mi servono le palette Tailwind (brand e neutri) e un font con carattere, niente shadcn.
evals.expected_output: Tailwind mode: @theme with --color-brand-50…950 holding #e85d04 at its step, a neutral choice, --font-sans (and heading if used), radius scale; preview with 2–3 candidates; asks which one.

evals.name: url-inspired
evals.prompt: Make me a theme inspired by https://linear.app for my analytics dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Asks Tailwind or shadcn first (no project context), extracts colours from the URL with the script instead of guessing, builds 2–3 candidates and a preview, explains how each relates to the source.
